Therefore, it is necessary for a bishop to be beyond reproach,
the husband of one wife, sober,
but a man who leads his own house well,
filios habentem subditos cum omni castitate.
having children who are subordinate with all chastity.
Si quis autem domui suæ præesse nescit,
For if a man does not know how to lead his own house,
how will he take care of the Church of God?
He must not be a new convert,
he may fall under the sentence of the devil.
Oportet autem illum et testimonium habere bonum ab iis qui foris sunt,
And it is necessary for him also to have good testimony from those who are outside,
so that he may not fall into disrepute
and the snare of the devil.
habentes mysterium fidei in conscientia pura.
holding to the mystery of the faith with a pure conscience.
And these things should be proven first,
Similarly, the women must be chaste,
Deacons should be the husband of one wife,
men who lead their own children
Qui enim bene ministraverint, gradum bonum sibi acquirent,
For those who have ministered well will acquire for themselves a good position,
et multam fiduciam in fide, quæ est in Christo Jesu.
and much confidence in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
I am writing these things to you,
sperans me ad te venire cito:
with the hope that I will come to you soon.
ut scias quomodo oporteat te in domo Dei conversari,
you should know the manner in which it is necessary to conduct yourself in the house of God,
which is the Church of the living God,
the pillar and the foundation of truth.
Et manifeste magnum est pietatis sacramentum,
And it is clearly great, this mystery of piety,
which was manifested in the flesh,
which was justified in the Spirit,
which has been preached to the Gentiles,
which is believed in the world,
which has been taken up in glory.
